says: In today's version, stylelint.test.ts's runnerRepo copies the whole live oxlint-plugins/ folder, so it walks into the git repo that plants.test.ts plants under oxlint-plugins/.plant-*/hide-* in another worker and fails when git deletes a file the copy just listed.
proof: PR 1235's run 43619801064, job test (6): `law 30 gives invalid options a path, fallback location and stylelint label` failed in 18 ms with `ENOENT: no such file or directory, lstat '.../oxlint-plugins/.plant-p7Ok9A/hide-0de03D/.git/index.lock'`. plants.test.ts:556 makes `hide-` folders inside its `.plant-` folder in oxlint-plugins/ and runs `git init` and `git add` in one. A scratch script on the laptop, Node 26.13.0, ran the test's exact `cpSync(join(ROOT, "oxlint-plugins"), ..., { recursive: true, filter })` for 20 s while another process ran `git add` in a planted repo there: 2 of 71 copies failed with `ENOENT ... lstat '<root>/oxlint-plugins/.plant-*/hide-*/.git/objects/.../tmp_obj_...'`. Copying only `git ls-files oxlint-plugins` for the same 20 s: 0 of 467 failed.
cost: Any pull request whose CI runs these two files at once can go red on law 30, and must be run again.
